accessibility.description: The iOS game combines VoiceOver navigation with sound and haptic feedback that communicate its sensor-based puzzles without sight. AppleVis corroborates readable elements and labeled controls. Challenges can require device movement, sound, particular times, or real-world conditions; accessibility feedback does not remove those puzzle requirements.
